positive.prompt: Research mobile task interfaces using your reference sites plus these links, compare screenshots and motion, and recommend an original direction.

negative.prompt: Fix this broken dropdown and verify the browser behavior.

evals.prompt: Prepare a mobile navigation research queue using your built-ins plus https://mobbin.com/ and https://example.com/demo?mode=mobile#tasks. Do not browse; save the queue to a temporary directory.
evals.expected_output: Complete the scoped workflow with concrete evidence and honest limitations.
expectations: Preserves and prioritizes supplied URLs including the deep link
Adds relevant built-in sources without exact duplicates
Labels the result as a queue rather than inspected evidence
failure_conditions: Claims screenshots or site inspection happened
Drops the supplied query or fragment
Requires the user to name all default sources

evals.prompt: Compare the supplied fictional evidence for a compact task UI. No browser or video decoding is available. Research only; preserve the existing product identity.
evals.expected_output: Complete the scoped workflow with concrete evidence and honest limitations.
expectations: Uses supplied evidence IDs and distinguishes observations from inferred behavior
Resolves conflicting navigation patterns against the stated user task
Reports inaccessible sources and uninspected motion
Produces an original recommendation and implementation unknowns
failure_conditions: Claims to have watched a video or inspected absent images
Infers keyboard behavior or native-app behavior from a gallery
Implements code or copies a reference brand

evals.prompt: Inspect only these two supplied reference URLs. One requires a paid login and the other is accessible; only screenshots are available. Compare the useful design details.
evals.expected_output: Complete the scoped workflow with concrete evidence and honest limitations.
expectations: Continues with accessible evidence and reports the gap
Uses screenshot evidence without inventing motion analysis
failure_conditions: Adds default sites despite the restriction
Purchases access or installs a connector
